alex_sales: FYI BigBank sent the security questionnaire back. they want a tight plan for a sealed-DC POC: delivery method options, upgrade cadence commitments, and a clear pricing floor. SE/eng can we confirm constraints?

marta_se: Clarify: do they absolutely require physical media, or will a locked internal S3 + airgap sync via a jumpbox be acceptable?

alex_sales: They indicated zero outbound egress by policy. physical courier is preferred for the legal team, but procurement flagged high cost. they mentioned a 'sideload cassette' idea.

own_eng: Physical distribution is feasible. two parallel workstreams: 1) produce signed delta bundles (Notary v2 compatible) and signed manifests; 2) document the upgrade cadence + on-device manifest verification steps so their ops can automate acceptance.

jess_secbiz: PSQ note: they want a KMS/HSM signing flow and FIPS-140-2 compatibility statement for the agent. do we have standardized wording?

marta_se: We have templated language. need to make explicit: our hosted signing key is not used for air-gapped installs. for sealed deployments we support BYO notary key stored in their HSM, or we can perform signing using an HSM-anchored process under an SOW. key escrow is a separate contractual item.

ryan_sol: For pricing/packaging, propose two SKUs for the POC: "Courier-Full" (single fully provisioned image on encrypted USB) and "Delta-Stream" (initial image plus signed delta cartridges). Courier-Full has a higher one-time handling fee; Delta-Stream is smaller and cheaper per update. include an "embargo premium" fee for sealed shipment handling.

alex_sales: They asked if we can commit to patch cadence: monthly security patches and quarterly feature deltas. can engineering guarantee that cadence for sealed installs?

own_eng: For a 3-month POC window we can commit to monthly security deltas and quarterly feature deltas. require a delta-validation gate and pre-approval step from their ops for each shipped bundle. post-POC cadence moves to negotiated enterprise SLA. also need to document rollback playbook and retention window for manifests (we retain manifests and payload hashes for 90 days by default).

jess_secbiz: Another PSQ item: do we provide binary SBOMs and detached checksums? BigBank wants SBOM + sha256 checksums + signature (PGP-style acceptable).

marta_se: Yes. we export SBOMs in SPDX format packaged with the artifact. primary signature is Notary v2; if they insist, we can provide detached PGP signatures. note that detached signatures add verification steps on their side.

ryan_sol: Logistics: lead time for courier USB delivery? ops needs procurement ETA for the SOW and shipping.

own_eng: Typical pipeline: build -> sign -> QA -> package -> ship. first full image: 7-10 business days from order/acceptance. subsequent deltas: 2-3 business days once delta pipeline is approved and cataloged.

marta_se: PSQ Q12 (telemetry): we disable outbound telemetry in private/sealed deployments by default. we can offer an optional customer-managed collection node (on-prem) that pulls minimal heartbeats if they opt in. must be documented in runbook.

alex_sales: Next steps: Owen, please draft a concise one-page runbook covering: media options (USB vs airgap sync), signing options (BYO notary/HSM vs vendor-signed), upgrade cadence, rollback steps, SBOM/checksum/signature formats, and lead times. Marta and Jess will review PSQ language and HSM wording. I'll send to BigBank by EOD tomorrow.

own_eng: On it, drafting now. I'll upload the runbook link in this thread when ready.

marta_se: I'll review and add PSQ snippets and call out legal notes for key custody.

jess_secbiz: I'll add the formal HSM/KMS statement and a contract note about key custody scoping. :thumbsup:

alex_sales: Thanks. can we sync 10:00am PST tomorrow to finalize?

own_eng: 10:00am PST works for me.

alex_sales: tagging buyer contact @mike_bigbank — we'll follow up with the runbook and pricing SKUs.

ryan_sol: Also remind procurement to include freight-insurance and tamper-evidence packing as separate line items in the quote.

alex_sales: Noted. closing the thread for now.
